# Hugging Face

> > The open-source AI community platform for discovering, sharing, and collaborating on models, datasets, and applications.

Hugging Face is the central hub for the machine learning community, providing access to hundreds of thousands of pre-trained models, datasets, and interactive spaces. The platform supports both individual researchers and enterprises with tools for model discovery, fine-tuning, deployment, and collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Transformers
- Model Hub
- Datasets
- Spaces
- Inference Endpoints
- PyTorch
- Open-source models

- Qwen3.5
- NVIDIA Nemotron
- Enterprise AI

## Core Platform

- [Hugging Face Home](https://huggingface.co): AI community platform for open source models and collaboration
- [Models Hub](https://huggingface.co/models): Model hub for discovering and exploring machine learning models across frameworks
- [Datasets Hub](https://huggingface.co/datasets): Dataset hub for browsing and accessing machine learning training datasets
- [Spaces](https://huggingface.co/spaces): Interactive ML apps and demos gallery showcasing community-built AI applications
- [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs): Documentation hub for Hugging Face libraries, tools, and platform features

## Infrastructure & Services

- [Pricing](https://huggingface.co/pricing): Pricing plans for Hub, Spaces, storage, and compute resources with hardware options
- [Storage](https://huggingface.co/storage): Storage buckets and data management solutions for AI projects and models
- [Enterprise Plans](https://huggingface.co/enterprise): Enterprise and team subscription plans with SSO, security, and collaboration features

## Featured Models

- [NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super-120B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-BF16): NVIDIA Nemotron 120B large language model with MoE, long context, and reasoning
- [Qwen3.5-35B-Uncensored](https://huggingface.co/HauhauCS/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive): Qwen3.5 35B language model with quantization variants and aggressive tuning
- [Qwen3.5-27B-Claude-Reasoning](https://huggingface.co/Jackrong/Qwen3.5-27B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled): Fine-tuned Qwen3.5 27B model with reasoning distillation and chain-of-thought
- [Fish Audio S2 Pro](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro): Fish Audio S2 Pro text-to-speech model with prosody and emotion control
- [OmniCoder-9B](https://huggingface.co/Tesslate/OmniCoder-9B): OmniCoder 9B coding agent model fine-tuned for code generation and agentic tasks

## Featured Datasets

- [Step-3.5-Flash-SFT](https://huggingface.co/datasets/stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-SFT): Step-3.5-Flash supervised fine-tuning dataset for chat model training
